about: Hand-kept: no market publishes a feed. Each rule: months (1-12), weekday (0 = Sunday, 6 = Saturday), optional weeks (which of that weekday in the month, e.g. [1, 3]), start/end (24h), optional from/to dates, and check: true when the dates aren't confirmed (the page then says to check before going). list: false keeps a market off the day-by-day list (it still shows in the Farmers markets box). Checked 2026-10-29.
